messages:
anya: ran a quick mini-smoke of a new speculative pipeline (wip name: samplecraft) on llama4t-13b-q4. saw ~1.8-1.9x token/s on our mixed holdout but a small longform quality dip.
matt: what was the simple config?
anya: paste:
```
model: llama4t-13b-q4
quant: q4_k_mixed
batch:8
short_prefix:32
spec_stage:1
fallback_prob:0.06
warmup_kv:128
seed:42
```
kevin: could be kv boundary or quant tail shift. can you run fp16 control and q4 without speculative?
anya: launching fp16-control, q4-no-spec, and q4+pref64 jobs now. ETA ~25m. tagging @eng-sre.
ops-bot: jobs started [sc-1735234567-a, sc-1735234567-b, sc-1735234567-c]. expected runtime 30m.
anya: fp16 control finished: artifacts at s3://redwood-sandbox/sc/1735234567/a. diff quicklook: speed win holds, paired accept rate down ~0.7% (p~0.02) concentrated on >512-token prompts.
samira: p=0.02 with 500 prompts warrants a small human batch. add variants: q4+ptq-refine and q4+adaptive-fallback.
matt: also collect per-token perplexity delta and top-10 entropy trends. if entropy collapses after spec, we should back off.
anya: queued 200-label human A/B with three arms (fp16, q4+pref64+adapt, q4+ptq). will post results here.
